correctness.rationale: For n≥2 and 0<lambda<1, let b_i=x_(i-1) XOR x_i. Rule60/102 outputs at site i are b_i or b_(i+1), so if equal that output bit is forced, and otherwise both bits can occur with positive probability. Zero is accessible in one step iff no isolated bit in x (no cyclic 010 or 101). Each cyclic b-word admits a smoothing output y preserving all forced positions and with all constant runs at least length two, hence y itself has no isolated bit and can reach zero next; a one-hot x has a forced nonzero update, establishing worst distance exactly 2. Four-overlap-state transition matrix for no-isolated cyclic words has characteristic polynomial (t²-t-1)(t²-t+1), giving exact A_n=phi^n+psi^n+2cos(n pi/3), including n=2; probability of chosen two-step path at least r^(2n), r=min(lambda,1-lambda), implies stated geometric tail and finite expectation. Independent bit-support brute for all 2≤n≤9 and recurrence n≤9 corroborated; finite experiments are not the infinite cyclic run proof.
